# QR Code Generator

`qrcode.js` is the unmodified runtime from npm `qrcode-generator@1.4.4` by Kazuhiko Arase, MIT licensed (copyright and license link retained in file header). Source: https://www.npmjs.com/package/qrcode-generator/v/1.4.4 . Package fetched with npm integrity verification; no install scripts were run.

SHA-256 of qrcode.js: `18ae399f81182bc9de916e9c77b195df20cc58d6f2d55a62b085a299f1bf1780`. QR codes are generated locally; URLs are not sent to a third party.
